messages:
deploybot: 🔔 Build pipeline started for canary rollout tag=v2.4.1 commit=9a3f2b8 env=staging

matt: saw this, starting watch. which matrix did we target?

maya: matrix=linux-py39,linux-py310,macos-py310,windows-py39. default parallelism=4

ci-runner: linux-py39: lint ▶️  success
ci-runner: linux-py39: unit-tests ▶️ failed (1 flaky)
ci-runner: linux-py310: lint ▶️ success
ci-runner: linux-py310: unit-tests ▶️ success
ci-runner: macos-py310: integration ▶️ success
ci-runner: windows-py39: integration ▶️ failed (timeout)

sarah: logs? paste the failing test stack for linux-py39 unit?

ci-runner: ```
FAILED tests/test_batching.py::TestKVCache::test_prefix_eviction
E   AssertionError: expected 0 entries but found 3
...
TimeoutError: subprocess timed out after 300s
```

matt: hmm that eviction failure smells like the new batching change in 9a3f2b8. @maya did we change the eviction window?

maya: yes, I relaxed the eviction threshold to favor latency. didn't expect it to surface like this. quick fix is to pin the rollout to previous worker image (tag 9a3f2b7) or revert the batching tweak.

liam: can we patch the test instead? this looks like a real behavior change; tests should reflect eviction semantics. but for rollout we need safety - recommend pin the runtime image in canary.

matt: agree. pin + rerun failing matrix only. pin window=canary-only. no global rollout.

deploybot: action required: set pin image=worker:9a3f2b7 for canary. responding to @matt

maya: doing pin now...

deploybot: ✅ Pin applied to canary: worker image -> worker:9a3f2b7

ci-runner: re-running failed jobs: linux-py39 unit-tests, windows-py39 integration

ci-runner: linux-py39: unit-tests ▶️ success
ci-runner: windows-py39: integration ▶️ flaky but passed on rerun (2/3 infra timeouts)

matt: nice. should we still hold the canary for the rest of the change window?

liam: hold for 1 hour for monitoring. set rollout=paused and run smoke traffic.

deploybot: Rollout status: paused by @liam. canary healthy checks pending (1h). tag=v2.4.1 commit=9a3f2b8 pinned_image=9a3f2b7

sarah: I'll add a short note to release notes: "Canary rolled back to worker:9a3f2b7 due to batching eviction deviation; patch to tests and follow-up revert planned."

maya: will open PR to revert the threshold tweak with test improvements: PR #8421

matt: ok. if no regressions in 1h we can resume canary to full rollout, but keep the pin until the patch merges.

liam: also update change window: extend by 30m in case we need another iteration. posting to calendar.

deploybot: notify: release notes updated draft by sarah. monitoring set for 1h. pinned flag active.

matt: thanks all. good job moving fast. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks. I'll watch logs and ping if anything else shows up.

ci-runner: final status: pipeline complete (with pinned fallback). artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/9a3f2b8/v2.4.1/

liam: leaving this thread open until patch merged.

matt: closing after PR merged or rollback decision.
